properties.query:
NetcraftTakedown_Unique
| where IngestedAt > ago(15m)
| where EventType == "takedown"
| where ChangeType == "new"
| extend
    ThreatUrl = iff(Threat matches regex @"(?i)^https?://", Threat, ""),
    ThreatIp = iff(isnotempty(parse_ipv4(Threat)) or isnotempty(parse_ipv6(Threat)), Threat, "")
| extend
    ThreatDomain = iff(isempty(ThreatUrl) and isempty(ThreatIp) and Threat !has "@" and Threat matches regex @"^[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}$", Threat, "")
| project
    TimeGenerated,
    EventId,
    ChangeType,
    Subject,
    TakedownId,
    GroupId,
    AttackType,
    Threat,
    ThreatUrl,
    ThreatIp,
    ThreatDomain,
    IsAuthorized,
    IsEscalated,
    IsMaliciousDomain,
    IsMaliciousHostname,
    Status,
    CustomerLabel,
    ActionRequired
properties.description:
Identifies new Netcraft Takedown records from the Integration Gateway (`EventType == "takedown"` and `ChangeType == "new"`).
Updates to an existing takedown do not alert; use the Takedown workbook to follow status changes. `IsAuthorized` and `IsEscalated` are booleans.
properties.name: Netcraft Takedown - New takedown
